package.name: rover_probe_detection
package.description: ERC probes in the rover's cameras: a per-camera 2D detector (model from the course project; not implemented yet) and a triangulator that turns the detections of several cameras into 3D probe positions, using CameraInfo and TF at each frame's capture time. Inputs come from rover_cameras; outputs are standard vision_msgs, so the arm side can consume them without depending on rover packages.
